cff1a417.text:
Many tribes claim that it is a gift to be blessed with the aptitude to use magic or to talk to our ancestors, but you should know this as well, $c, you are just as gifted. Some do not have the strength in their arms to wield mighty weapons. Some do not have the skill to parry a blow from an assassin, or to even suffer the physical punishments from an arcane spellcaster, but you do. You are strong. And I will help you become stronger. Find me in Camp Narache.

-Harutt Thunderhorn, $C Trainer
cff1a417.title: Simple Note

10278|46a7802e.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|46a7802e.text: Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.

10278|b24d3eb1.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|b24d3eb1.text: I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

11869|b4d7a83a.name: Ansekhwa
11869|b4d7a83a.text:
Sayoc is the orc weapon master and is located in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.  He instructs in the use of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons.

Hanashi, the troll weapon master in the Valley of Honor of Orgrimmar, can teach the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and thrown weapons.

Archibald, the undead weapon master in the War Quarter of the Undercity, can train the use of crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.

277055|74f9b051.name: Edine Sharphorn
277055|74f9b051.text:
Welcome to my barbershop! We offer cuts, colorings, and more.

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, reshape tusks and horns, and even modify undead features!

Have a seat and we'll get to work.

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

2998|d71c40e9.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|d71c40e9.text: You have great potential, but you must achieve understanding first, you must accept the spirits and listen to their calling. Only then will you be prepared for the path you must follow. Go speak with Thrag, I think perhaps you can learn a lot from one another.

3052|25d0fbd5.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|25d0fbd5.text: Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

3059|4711dbab.name: Harutt Thunderhorn
3059|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3060|7b785024.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|7b785024.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  May your ancestors watch over you $c.

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3084|769ecbc7.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|769ecbc7.text: Looking to learn how to work an anvil and hammer, eh?  Karn Stonehoof can teach you how.  He has a smithy set up on the lower rise by the pond.

3084|a93675fd.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a93675fd.text: Ah, you seek the wisdom of Ansekhwa.  Look for him on the lower rise at Thunder Bluff Weapons.

3217|12ef1a85.name: Brave Dawneagle
3217|12ef1a85.text: There is a Blacksmithing Trainer in our great home Thunder Bluff to the north.  If you seek such knowledge then head there and ask one of the Bluffwatchers for directions.

3217|b9129861.name: Brave Dawneagle
3217|b9129861.text: Nothing frees the spirit like soaring through the sky.  There is such a place in our great tribal center Thunder Bluff.  The road north out of Bloodhoof Village will guide you there.  Once you ride the elevator to the top speak with one of the Bluffwatchers who can give you further directions.

4596|49a65401.name: James Van Brunt
4596|49a65401.text: Want to be a smith? Want to forge blades to gut your foe? Hammers to crush his skull? Aye I can help, and gladly too if there is blood to be shed from it.

4605|1690954e.name: Basil Frye
4605|1690954e.text: I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.

5624|ddc32579.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|ddc32579.text: Go to inner ring of War Quarter.  Brom Killian there.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6747|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

95805-complete.name: Unknown
95805-complete.text: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805-complete.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95805-progress.name: Unknown
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

97935-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97935-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97935-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97935-complete.name: Brek Stonehoof
97935-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97935-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining
